name: WereRat 2x Scale Test
author: vkays
description: Test mod for the GR2 round-trip pipeline: scales the WereRat model 2x via scale_model.py, which scales vertex positions and every bone's local translation (leaving rotation/scale_shear untouched) then recomputes InverseWorldTransform from the patched hierarchy, all mathematically self-consistent. Purpose is to confirm this produces a proportioned 2x scale with no joint stretching, unlike the earlier vertex-only and InitialPlacement-only attempts.
